title: Former Intelligence Officer David Grusch Says The Government Has Seen Greek God Aliens And 7-Foot Reptile Gorillas, And They Are Fighting Each Other Here On Earth
excerpt: Read more about Former Intelligence Officer David Grusch Says The Government Has Seen Greek God Aliens And 7-Foot Reptile Gorillas, And They Are Fighting Each Other Here On Earth on https://www.barstoolsports.com/
content:
AOL News- Just when one thought that UFO stories couldn't get any wilder, whistleblower David Grusch spilled some bombshell claims on the Joe Rogan podcast. Grusch, a retired US Air Force intelligence officer and National Reconnaissance Office representative to the UAP Task Force, claimed that he has seen audio-video footage of alien species that travelled in differently shaped UFOs.

What stood out most from his claims was his description of beings that resembled Greek gods, 7-foot-tall reptiles, and small gray aliens. Grusch claimed that he learned about these accounts while working with the UAP Task Force in 2020. During his appearance on Joe Rogan's podcast, he claimed to see footage of military personnel at the contemporary UFO crash site where they allegedly discovered four dead alien bodies. Grusch described them as:

"Human like in form and appeared to be like Greek Gods."

"I know it sounds schizo": UFO whistleblower David Grusch talks about Greek god and gorilla-reptile shaped aliens

While speaking about aliens on Joe Rogan's podcast, Grusch said,

"I'm like, I cannot believe I'm talking about this on Joe Rogan. And I mean, I know it sounds schizo."

However, he also believes that one day the truth will be revealed. During Joe Rogan's podcast, he clarified that he never personally witnessed the phenomenon of encountering alien beings himself. However, he claimed that he did see classified audio-video footage related to the government operations.

"I got to see the audio visual on that. It's contemporary."

Grusch claimed he saw footage of the crash retrieval event, including footage of deceased non-human cadavers. He claimed the deceased beings looked quite human-like and were pale bluish-white in color. Speaking about the aliens, Grusch said that they were very beautiful and resembled Greek gods.

The former US Air Force intelligence officer said that he was shown the footage as part of his investigation.

Grusch also spoke about aliens that resembled a gorilla-reptile. He claimed that some of his colleagues saw these creatures alive. The UFO whistleblower said that he never saw them in person, but his colleagues described the creatures as

"Seven foot tall plus gorilla-looking...scaly skin though."

I would like an apology from everybody. Not immediately, no, you can take some time, and gather your thoughts. But at some point, I would like a formal apology from everybody who has looked at me like I needed to be institutionalized whenever I said I believe the government knows a hell of a lot more about UFOs and aliens than they've ever told us. And that tehre are several different species/races of aliens that exist- some of them cohabitating on this very planet, and walking amongst us.

Because apparently we're not even debating the subject anymore. Experts are now discussing seven-foot reptile gorillas fighting gray aliens in the sky. Which, admittedly, is a tough sentence for me to type while simultaneously arguing that I'm NOT crazy.

But here we are.

David Grusch went back on Joe Rogan last week and casually dropped one of the craziest two hours of information I have ever heard in my life. Also, its impirtant to note that David Grusch isn't some guy named GalacticWarrior1776 posting YouTube videos from inside a van.

He's a former Air Force intelligence officer. He worked in the intelligence community for years, and he represented the National Reconnaissance Office on the government's UAP Task Force. This is a guy who had incredibly high-level security clearances and whose literal job was looking into this kind of shit.

He also went in front of Congress under oath in 2023 and told them he had been informed of a secret, decades-long crash retrieval and reverse-engineering program involving non-human craft.

So when that guy starts telling Joe Rogan about fucking reptile gorillas, we should be all ears.

There are hundreds of billions of stars in our galaxy alone, there are planets everywhere, and the universe is so gigantic our brains can't even comprehend it. But for some reason our concept of alien life has basically been- little gray guys, with big heads, huge eyes, butt ass naked, and thats basically it.

Turns out, according to Grusch, we may have ourselves an entire fucking zoo. He claims he was shown classified footage from a contemporary crash retrieval that included three or four dead beings that looked basically human, except they were pale or bluish-white and unusually beautiful.

He said they resembled "Greek gods."

Oh the irony that we are finally getting confirmation that humanity isn't alone in the universe, something our species has wondered about since basically the beginning of civilization, and the first aliens they roll out are 6'5", perfectly symmetrical, silver-haired Adonises. High comedy indeed. They couldn't send down one alien built like George Costanza?

Giphy Images.

No sir. They're fucking Greek gods.

Grusch said that these humanoid beings were associated with "boomerang- or crescent-shaped craft." 

And then there are the reptilians, and this is where I'm going to lose some of you. Grusch said he personally never saw these creatures, but that people he worked with described living beings that were seven feet tall or taller, built somewhat like gorillas, with scaly skin.

Grusch himself acknowledged how completely insane that sounded, which, weirdly, makes me trust him more. Because if somebody tells me with total confidence that seven-foot lizard gorillas are flying Tic Tacs around Earth, I'm giving him one of those "oh yah ok" nods.

Giphy Images.

But Grusch is essentially sitting there saying, "I understand how fucking ridiculous the words coming out of my mouth sound. Unfortunately this is what people involved in these programs told me."

Then he followed that up with something I did not know or have ever heard before, and he claims that there are apparently different TYPES of reptilians. There are little grays. Tall grays. The beautiful Greek-god-looking humanoids. Possibly insect-looking things, (although Grusch made it clear he's only heard rumors about those and doesn't claim firsthand knowledge.)

And then we get to my favorite part of the entire interview, which was the question on why do UFOs keep crashing?

Excellent question asked by Joe. I have always wondered this because you're telling me these beings figured out interstellar travel, bent space-time, traversed potentially millions of light years, made it all the way to Earth and then just crashed in fucking New Mexico? That's like crossing the Atlantic Ocean in a nuclear submarine and then accidentally driving it into the fountain at the Bellagio. How does that happen?

Well, Grusch had an answer for that too.

According to him, some of these crashes aren't accidents- they're apparently fighting each other. Yes, a legit "alien war". Different non-human species allegedly have beef.

He talks about an incident involving a reptilian craft and dead gray beings that, according to the information given to him, suggested some kind of conflict between the two, so apparently Earth isn't just being visited, but its a battlefield. 

We're sitting here spending our entire existence worried about Russia, China, Iran and North Korea while a seven-foot lizard and a three-foot gray guy are having Top Gun dogfights 80,000 feet above us. Meanwhile we're down here arguing about whether a dress is blue or gold. And allegedly humans have gotten involved too, because Grusch relayed an account in which living reptilian beings survived a crash and were ultimately shot and killed after American military personnel were reportedly killed. 

(Imagine being the soldier who shot and killed alien life form(s) who killed American military personnel? Talk about a hero.)

Giphy Images.

Maybe these people keep saying this stuff because some of it is actually fucking true. And if the day ever comes when the President walks out to a podium with a seven-foot reptile standing next to him and announces that we've been interacting with non-human intelligence since 1947, I don't want to hear a fucking word from any of you doubters.

p.s.- is Tim DIllon ever wrong?
